EMERGENCY FIRST AID

❤️ CPR (No Breathing)

1. Place heel of hand on center of chest.
2. Interlock fingers, keep arms straight.
3. Push hard and fast (100-120 compressions/min).

Follow the beat above for timing

🩸 Severe Bleeding

1. Apply direct pressure to the wound with a clean cloth.
2. Maintain pressure continuously.
3. Elevate the injured area if possible.

😮 Choking

1. Stand behind the person.
2. Make a fist just above their navel.
3. Give quick, upward thrusts (Heimlich Maneuver).
